description: Verifies that the system identifies known hazards according to FDA food safety regulations (21 CFR 117.130)
input_data: A list of known hazards for a specific food product
expected_output: The identified hazards are correctly listed and categorized in the system
steps: Load the known hazards list for a specific food product into the system
Run the hazard identification process using the loaded data
Compare the output of the hazard identification process with the expected hazards list
notes: Assumption: The system is properly configured and functioning as intended. Special condition: Test should be conducted by a trained professional familiar with FDA food safety regulations.

description: Verifies that the hazard analysis is written and accessible as per 21 CFR 117.130
steps: Retrieve the Hazard Analysis document from the system or repository
Verify that the document is in a readable format (e.g., PDF, Word)
Review the document to ensure it contains a written hazard analysis
notes: Assumption: The Hazard Analysis document has been properly created and stored within the system or repository

description: Verifies that the food safety management system identifies and controls biological hazards as per FDA regulations.
input_data: Sample of raw materials, work environment swabs, finished product samples
expected_output: Documented identification and control measures for identified biological hazards
steps: Collect samples from raw materials, work environment, and finished products
Analyze the collected samples using appropriate testing methods to identify potential biological hazards
Review the food safety management system's records to ensure that control measures are in place for identified biological hazards
notes: Assumes that appropriate testing methods and food safety management system are available. Special conditions may include changes in raw materials, work environment, or finished products.

description: Verify the assessment of severity and probability of hazard occurrence in accordance with 21 CFR 117.130
input_data: Food safety hazards identified during risk analysis
expected_output: Documented assessments of severity and probability for each identified hazard
steps: Identify food safety hazards through a risk analysis process
Assess the severity of each identified hazard based on its potential to cause illness or injury
Assess the probability of each identified hazard occurring during food production, processing, or distribution
notes: This test assumes that the food safety risk analysis and assessment methods comply with FDA regulations (21 CFR 117.135)

description: Verify the evaluation of environmental pathogens for ready-to-eat foods
input_data: Samples of ready-to-eat food products and their corresponding environmental samples
expected_output: Results indicating the presence or absence of specified environmental pathogens in the ready-to-eat food samples
steps: Collect samples of ready-to-eat food products and their corresponding environmental samples
Perform testing to identify the presence of environmental pathogens using approved methods
Analyze test results to determine if they meet regulatory requirements
notes: Assumption: Testing is performed by a qualified laboratory following FDA guidelines and standards
